name: The First Beam of Morning
prompt: Align low colonnades with a slit in a stone screen. A narrow shaft of sunlight reaches a bronze bowl while attendants polish small mirrors along the processional path.

name: The Offering Weighhouse
prompt: Place a great balance in a roofless temple court. Worshippers set baskets of fruit on one pan while an attendant lays carved stone birds of different weights on the other.

name: A Roof of Fired Leaves
prompt: Build a temple restoration court around a half-tiled roof. Potters press leaf shapes into wet clay and pass fired tiles up a scaffold to complete a gleaming overlapping canopy.

name: The Listening Cistern
prompt: Sink a stepped cistern into an ancient sanctuary. Water pours from carved mouths at three heights as visitors lean over stone listening niches cut into the staircase.

name: The Festival Door
prompt: Lay a monumental carved timber door flat beside its temple gateway. A procession paints the panels while a team turns a capstan to raise the finished door on its hinge.
